[1/3] Measure the gate's models concurrently (child-process lanes like tune-scheduler): a bounded model pool, --models-parallel with sequential fallback, per-model cache and comparability preserved, first-error-at-end semantics

impact_assessment.why: The gate is the only remaining sequential cold cost; per-model inference config stays bit-identical so answers cannot change, only wall time
impact_assessment.benefits: Cold gate wall time drops from the sum of the three models to the slowest (about 1.8-2x)
impact_assessment.risks: contract: stdout interleaves per model and a failing model aborts at end-of-batch instead of mid-loop; dependency: none; concurrency: three in-process engines initialize simultaneously (memory-checked, ~2GB total q4); state: each model keeps its own gate-cache file and fingerprint
impact_assessment.mitigation: Bounded pool unit-tested for concurrency and ordering; live cold dogfood must reproduce all nine verdicts at delta zero; --models-parallel 1 restores today's behavior

[1/4] Plan and failing-first tests for the two-digest gate cache split: answer identity (engine closure + tune-evaluate/tune/tune-job + world fingerprint incl taskHash) for row reuse; judge identity (tune-gate/tune-measure/tasks) re-verdicts from reusable rows; schema 2 discards schema 1; tripwire rotation and --fresh unchanged

impact_assessment.why: the single reuse fingerprint burns all cached answers whenever any gate driver changes, e.g. the CLI entry guards cost a full 111s re-warm though they cannot affect an answer
impact_assessment.benefits: judge-only changes (gate orchestration, stats, rungs) reuse bit-identical answers and only re-judge, saving a full cold re-measure on harness-only commits
impact_assessment.risks: contract: reusing answers under a stale answer identity would hide quality drift; dependency: none; concurrency: none (paint points per model as today); state: cache schema bump discards all schema-1 rows once
impact_assessment.mitigation: answer identity keeps every answer-affecting input (engine closure, prompt and settings assembly, taskHash/suiteVersion/tunerVersion/model/runtime); verdicts are recomputed each run by the live judge code; the tripwire still measures a fresh rotating window; --fresh unchanged; failing-first tests prove schema-1 discard and identity discrimination
